seo.title: How to Rank in ChatGPT: 9 Steps to Get Recommended
seo.meta_description: How to rank in ChatGPT answers: let OAI-SearchBot crawl you, answer questions directly, earn brand mentions, and track ChatGPT referrals and leads.

h1: How to Rank in ChatGPT: 9 Steps to Get Your Brand Recommended
answer: To rank in ChatGPT, make sure OpenAI's OAI-SearchBot can crawl your site, publish pages that answer buyers' exact questions in the first lines, back claims with specific facts and sources, and earn consistent brand mentions on sites ChatGPT trusts. Then track ChatGPT referrals and leads to see which pages it actually recommends.
key_takeaways: ChatGPT has no ranked list; it names a few brands and cites sources when it searches the web.
OAI-SearchBot must be allowed to crawl your pages for them to appear in ChatGPT search results.
Pages that answer the exact question early, with specifics, are the easiest to cite.
Mentions of your brand on other trusted sites strongly shape what ChatGPT says about you.
Visits from chatgpt.com show up in analytics, so you can measure what works.

sections.heading: What it means to rank in ChatGPT
sections.body_html:
ChatGPT does not show ten blue links. When it answers a question that needs current information, it can search the web, read sources and write a response, often with links to the pages it used. For questions it answers from training alone, it draws on what it learned about brands and topics.

So "ranking" in ChatGPT really means three things:

  • Being mentioned by name when someone asks for options or recommendations.
  • Being described correctly: your specialty, location and strengths.
  • Being cited with a link when ChatGPT searches the web.

You influence all three with the same steps.

sections.heading: Step 1–3: Let ChatGPT find and read your site
sections.body_html:
1. Allow OAI-SearchBot

OpenAI documents several crawlers. OAI-SearchBot is used to surface websites in ChatGPT's search features; GPTBot is used for training; ChatGPT-User fetches pages when a user asks. If your robots.txt or firewall blocks OAI-SearchBot, your pages cannot appear in ChatGPT search results. You can allow search while still blocking training if you prefer.

2. Make sure pages are indexable and fast

Pages that load slowly, depend entirely on JavaScript, or sit behind logins are hard for any crawler to read. Keep key content in the HTML, use clean URLs, and include every important page in your sitemap.

3. Tell crawlers about new pages quickly

Submit your sitemap in search tools and use IndexNow, which notifies participating search engines such as Bing the moment a page is published or updated.

sections.heading: Step 4–6: Write pages ChatGPT wants to quote
sections.body_html:
4. Answer the exact question first

Start each page with a 40–60 word answer that uses the words buyers use. If someone asks "what does a GEO agency cost", your page should say it plainly in the first lines, then explain.

5. Be specific and cite sources

Research on generative engines found that adding citations, quotations and statistics made sources noticeably more visible in AI answers, while keyword stuffing did not help. Replace general claims with numbers, named methods, examples and references.

6. Structure for passages

Use question-style headings, short paragraphs, comparison tables and FAQs. Each section should make sense if quoted on its own, because that is how it will be used.

sections.heading: Step 7–8: Build the reputation ChatGPT relies on
sections.body_html:
7. Earn mentions on trusted sites

When ChatGPT recommends providers, it leans on what the wider web says: reviews, "best of" lists, directories, industry publications, Reddit and community discussions, and partner pages. A brand that appears consistently in those places is far easier to recommend than one that only describes itself.

Practical ways to earn mentions: contribute expert quotes to industry articles, get listed in the directories your buyers use, collect detailed reviews, publish original data others want to reference, and keep partner and supplier pages up to date.

8. Describe your brand the same way everywhere

Use one clear description of what you do, who you serve and where, on your homepage, About page, social profiles, directory listings and Organization schema. Inconsistency makes an AI engine less confident about what you are best at.

sections.heading: Step 9: Measure what ChatGPT sends you
sections.body_html:
Visitors who click links in ChatGPT usually arrive with chatgpt.com as the referrer, and ChatGPT often adds utm_source=chatgpt.com to links. In Google Analytics, group these visits into an "AI search" channel alongside perplexity.ai, gemini.google.com, copilot.microsoft.com and claude.ai.

Then track:

  • Which landing pages ChatGPT sends visitors to.
  • How those visitors convert compared with search visitors.
  • A fixed list of 20–50 buyer questions you test in ChatGPT each month, recording whether you are mentioned and cited.

People who read a recommendation and later search your brand name show up as branded search instead, so watch branded search growth too.

sections.heading: What a page ChatGPT recommends looks like
sections.body_html:
When ChatGPT recommends a provider, the pages it cites tend to share the same building blocks. Use this as a template for your most important service or comparison pages:

  • A one-line description of who you are, what you do and who you serve, in the first paragraph.
  • A direct answer to the question the page targets, in plain language.
  • Specifics: service areas, price ranges or how pricing works, timelines, and what is included.
  • Proof: named clients where you have permission, case results with numbers, reviews and certifications.
  • Comparisons: how your approach differs from alternatives, including when you are not the right fit.
  • FAQs that mirror real follow-up questions.
  • A clear next step, such as a short form, so the visitor ChatGPT sends you can act right away.

Pages built this way serve people and AI engines equally well, which is exactly the point.

sections.heading: Mistakes that keep brands out of ChatGPT answers
sections.body_html:
• Blocking AI crawlers by accident through a security plugin or CDN setting.
  • Hiding the answer under long introductions, sliders or tabs that need clicks.
  • Thin, repetitive pages produced in bulk. They rarely get cited and can hurt search visibility.
  • No proof: claims without examples, data or reviews give ChatGPT little reason to trust you.
  • Inconsistent business details across the web.
  • Checking once and giving up. AI answers vary between sessions; track trends over many questions.

sections.heading: A 30-day plan to rank in ChatGPT
sections.body_html:
WeekFocusOutput
1Baseline and accessList of 30 buyer questions tested in ChatGPT; robots.txt and firewall allow OAI-SearchBot
2Fix key pagesHomepage and top service pages open with direct answers, FAQs and schema
3New answer pagesPages for the five highest-intent questions you are not mentioned for
4Reputation and trackingDirectory and review profiles updated; AI search channel live in analytics

Repeat the question test at the end of the month and keep going on whatever moved.

faqs.q: How do I rank in ChatGPT?
faqs.a: Allow OpenAI's OAI-SearchBot to crawl your site, publish pages that answer buyers' exact questions in the first lines with specific, sourced facts, keep your brand description consistent, and earn mentions on trusted sites. Then track ChatGPT referrals to see what works.

faqs.q: Can I pay to rank in ChatGPT?
faqs.a: ChatGPT's organic answers are not something you can buy a position in. You improve your chances by being the clearest, best-supported source and the most consistently described brand for the questions your buyers ask.

It is OpenAI's crawler for ChatGPT's search features. Allowing it in robots.txt lets your pages be shown and linked in ChatGPT search results. It is separate from GPTBot, which OpenAI uses for training.

faqs.q: How long does it take to appear in ChatGPT answers?
faqs.a: When ChatGPT searches the web, a well-structured page can be cited soon after it is crawled. Mentions that rely on what the model learned in training change more slowly, often over months as your brand appears on more trusted sites.

faqs.q: How can I see if ChatGPT sends me traffic?
faqs.a: Look for visits with chatgpt.com as the source or referrer in Google Analytics, often tagged utm_source=chatgpt.com. Group them with other AI referrers into one channel and compare their conversion rate with search traffic.
Not directly. ChatGPT search uses its own crawler and third-party search providers. In practice, pages that are well structured, trustworthy and widely referenced tend to do well in both.
